digest.component_or_area: LLM code review overlay registration and dispatch
propositions: The concurrency overlay must be added to the OVERLAY_IDS enum in registry.py and will auto-derive the include_concurrency flag and schema without manual schema edits

A committed list of 41 concurrency-related substrings (Mutex, RwLock, Lock, Semaphore, pthread_, flock, Thread, tokio::spawn, etc.) must be added to content_triggered_overlays to detect concurrency patterns in added and removed diff lines, excluding context-only matches

The concurrency overlay dispatch must be wired into code-review.yaml with two lines: one in round_a gated on steps.triggers.outputs.include_concurrency and one in round_b gated on steps.union.outputs.include_concurrency, following the existing per-overlay pattern
Routing configuration in criteria_routing.json must specify concurrency as advisory posture with 0.95 block_threshold and blocking_enabled: false

Unit tests must verify trigger fire rate on corpus-derived diffs (added start_new_session=True, removed sync.Mutex), negative controls (async/await-only and context-line-only tokens), and threshold_for output
